about: Walks held in one direction until the player stopped, on BDSP's story maps, in the decomp frames of games/bdsp/maps/. 'held' is whether the player was held in place (a wall) rather than leaving the known maps. Places are [map, x, y]. The stops were measured on the console in the image-traced frames (12 px rows) and translated with the per-landmark offsets of the 2026-10-31 decomp comparison; the tile counts are the decomp's, since the image frames' counts came from their compressed rows. 'pending' lists measurements the decomp does not reproduce, to re-measure. Checked by python/tests/test_games_bdsp.py.

walks.source: console, from the post-catch save: stops at the wall below the grass (the image frame counted 5 over its 3 grass rows; the decomp has 5)
console run r75: the east wall is at column 30 on the row above the south ledge
console run r75: column 29 is open up to the trees above row 4 (the image frame counted 12 over its compressed rows)

console: stops above the Poke Mart where the road narrows; the image frame had the stop one row further south, where the decomp has the Mart's wall, so the row is the decomp's (the 9-tile walk west from here fits it)
console: stops above the Pokemon Center's sign (the image frame counted 3)
map: through the gap east of the north ledge, over the south ledge, into Sandgem Town

pending.source: console: stopped facing the Potion giver, who stood at (43, 10)
pending.reason: the decomp has her standing at (44, 10) (so the walk would stop at (45, 10) after 7); in BDSP she wanders, so the stop depends on where she is
